entities.name: Mariné Russo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mariné Russo is a retired field hockey player from Argentina who won the bronze medal at the 2004 and 2008 Summer Olympics with the Argentina national team. Mariné also won two World Cups, four Champions Trophy, the gold medal at the 2007 Pan American Games and two Pan American Cups. She was affiliated with Quilmes Atletico Club in Buenos Aires.
